limits: Two test matrices cover unary/server-streaming and uncompressed/gzip sends. Policy peers see three identical decoded requests with expected compression flag/header; explicit refusal makes one eventual handler execution and one transparent retry.
Before repair each policy matrix cell serialized three times, and each transparent-refusal cell serialized twice. Both now serialize once.
Retained request buffers remain governed by the existing encoding caps and per-attempt byte admission. Shared Bytes payloads are cloned for attempts; no performance claim is made.

FL-08 seeded side-effect histories and its remaining cancellation/oversize resource qualification remain open. The 46 passed interop cases and 8 explicitly unsupported Go compression cases do not certify the full advertised peer/profile matrix.
